hostPorts.purpose: Provider-neutral money movement adapter for payout setup, platform-balance transfers, connected-account payouts, and payout webhooks.
Durable transactional email outbox consumed only by event projectors.

wallets.purpose: Own wallets feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the settlement context.
wallets.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

payouts.purpose: Own payouts feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the settlement context.
payouts.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

payout-readiness.purpose: Own payout readiness behavior, provider requirement state, read models, and UI contracts for the settlement context.
payout-readiness.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide reusable request-support assets shared by settlement-owned features and composition seams.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
request-support.createdFor: settlement workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.
